rulesTestNames: lets guests read only their own messaging permission rows
owner: messaging contact permission writer, called in the same transaction by every consent writer
read: the guest gets and lists only rows whose uid is theirs, while their account is not deleted; a row not written yet reads as missing
write: server only; written from the sender's contact permission in the transaction of every consent decision, deleted at account deletion
migrationNotes: preference is the sender's WhatsApp summary from users/{uid}/contactPermissions, the one a withdrawal returns. The row is deleted once the guest minimum-build floor passes a build that reads contactPermissions (issue #2460, step 4).
